messages:
mika (ml): Quick heads-up — ran PTQ bringup for ranker-rk3b-v2 on the short-query holdout. NDCG looks fine (+0.4%), but MRR dropped ~3% (top1 takes the hit). Posting quick smoke results + checklist for triage.

owen: ugh. can you paste the exact eval command + the small sample of per-query deltas?

mika (ml): ran: `./eval_harness --model=ranker-rk3b-v2 --quant=ptq4bit --holdout=short_queries --metrics=ndcg,mrr --seed=42`
results summary: `ndcg@10: +0.4%`  `mrr@10: -3.1%`  `top1_accuracy: -4.6%`

tess: did we change tokenizer / preproc between builds? short queries are sensitive to whitespace/tokenization.

mika (ml): no tokenizer change since last golden. the only config diff was candidate_normalization.strip_html set to true in the PTQ pipeline (we thought it was harmless).

kai: could stripping html shift short query matches? also float rounding after quant could reorder very-close scores. can you run per-example diffs with seed and show top-3 deltas?

mika (ml): running now. sample diff (old -> quant):
```
qid: 12345   old_scores: [0.92, 0.91, 0.10]   new_scores: [0.90, 0.88, 0.12]
qid: 12346   old_scores: [0.57, 0.56, 0.55]   new_scores: [0.53, 0.58, 0.54]
delta_mrr: -0.72, +0.08, -0.01
```

samir: two quick experiments to try: (1) rerun PTQ with larger calib batch (`--calib-batches=1024`) and (2) try embed-rescale tweak (`--embed-rescale=1.02`) — sometimes embedding magnitude shift helps ranker stability.

mika (ml): queued both. also going to try `--prefix-cache=off` to rule out KV cache interaction on short contexts.

ci-bot: Deploy job queued: rerank-quant-smoke-3298765432 (job id: dq-7821) :gear:

owen: also double-check sample representation — our short-query holdout has only ~8% of samples. maybe it's underweighted in the golden set; need stratified gating.

tess: proposal: gating rules should include query-length buckets. if any bucket sees MRR <= -1% we block rollout. currently global thresholds hide concentrated regressions.

mika (ml): agreed. for this bringup I will: 1) run calib-batches=1024 + embed-rescale=1.02 2) disable prefix-cache and retest 3) produce stratified report (short/medium/long) and per-qid diffs 4) hold rollout until short-bucket MRR >= -1%

okay? ETA ~2h, will attach artifacts (diff CSV + eval command output).

owen: sounds good. add a quick dashboard link once available so product teams can eyeball the tail.

tess: blocking rollout until we see the stratified numbers. :no_entry_sign:

mika (ml): sending updates in this thread. thanks. :pray:
